title: Fix blank screen regression when selecting a record to edit/delete

requirements.text: Fix the regression where selecting a pickup record in the Edit/Delete Record flow causes the app to render a blank screen; ensure the dialog transitions to the edit form reliably without throwing any runtime errors.

quotes: Something broke in the last build, now editing records doesn't work. Once a record is selected a blank screen.

acceptanceCriteria: From the Edit/Delete Record dialog, clicking any pickup in the list does not result in a blank screen.
After selecting a pickup, the edit form renders with the selected pickup’s data populated.
No uncaught exceptions are thrown in the browser console during record selection and edit-form rendering.

requirements.text: Harden Edit/Delete Record UI rendering against malformed/empty pickup fields so it cannot crash: add defensive handling for time/date conversions, numeric formatting (e.g., toFixed), and any nullable/optional fields on the selected pickup.

quotes: Once a record is selected a blank screen.

acceptanceCriteria: If a pickup has missing/empty fields (e.g., empty time string, unexpected numeric values), the edit screen still renders and shows safe fallbacks instead of crashing.
Pickup totals displayed in the list and/or edit form never call numeric formatting on undefined/NaN values (no crashes from e.g. toFixed).

requirements.text: Ensure the Edit/Delete Record actions still work end-to-end after the regression fix: saving an edited pickup updates successfully and returns the user to the pickup list; deleting removes the pickup and returns the user to the pickup list; errors are surfaced in the dialog via existing toast messaging rather than a blank screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing a pickup and clicking Save persists changes (via backend updatePickup) and the dialog returns to the pickup list view.
Deleting a pickup persists deletion (via backend deletePickup) and the dialog returns to the pickup list view.
On backend or network failure, the app remains usable (no blank screen) and shows an English error toast.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing shadcn components instead).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add a migration file if state schema changes are required (avoid schema changes for this fix if possible).
nonGoals: Adding new features to the record model or introducing new admin flows.
Changing authentication behavior or Internet Identity integration.
UI redesign unrelated to fixing the edit-record blank screen regression.
